The '''Lorman family''' was a lineage from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] with powerful political connections. [[Gelmid Lorman]] used his connections to rise to the position of Moff and later became [[Minister of Logistics]] under [[Darth Acina|Empress Acina]].
